note: The session's web-search allowance was already used up, so no search was run for anyone: each name was looked for only on its county's, the courts' or the Legislature's own pages (fetched with the kit's honest User-Agent) and in ballot/lean/nd_endorsements.json. A blank means not found that way, not that nothing exists; no campaign websites could be looked for. County sites not reached (address unknown, or 429): Benson, Kidder, Sheridan, Towner. Duane Poitra (District 9 House) and John Kelly (District 29 Senate) are on the Dem-NPL's legislative candidate list (https://demnpl.com/2026legislativecandidates/), whose lines do not say 'endorsed', so no endorsement is recorded for them. Cassandra Sampson (Bottineau) and Thomas Larson (Burleigh) appear on their counties' pages as a deputy treasurer and an elections coordinator: staff posts, not offices, so not recorded.
